tasks.build:all: deno task build:release && deno task build:ffi && deno task build:wasm && deno task build:wasm:parse
tasks.build:wasm: deno task build:wasm:deno && deno task build:wasm:web && deno task build:wasm:node
tasks.build:wasm:parse: deno task build:wasm:parse:deno && deno task build:wasm:parse:web && deno task build:wasm:parse:node
tasks.build:wasm:parse:deno: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target deno --release --out-dir pkg/deno-parse -- --features ast
tasks.build:wasm:parse:web: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target web --release --out-dir pkg/web-parse -- --features ast
tasks.build:wasm:parse:node: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target nodejs --release --out-dir pkg/node-parse -- --features ast
tasks.dev: cargo watch -x 'check --workspace' -x 'test --workspace' || echo '⚠️  cargo-watch not installed. Run: cargo install cargo-watch'
tasks.check: deno task typecheck && deno task test && deno task lint && deno fmt --check && deno task check:ast-types
tasks.bench: deno task build:ffi && deno task build:wasm:deno && deno task build:wasm:parse:deno && deno task bench:run
tasks.corpus:compare: deno task build:ffi:corpus && TSV_FFI_PROFILE=corpus deno task corpus:compare:run
tasks.publish:npm:build:fmt: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target bundler --release --scope fuzdev --out-dir pkg/npm-fmt && deno run --allow-read --allow-write=crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/npm-fmt --allow-run=gzip scripts/publish_patch_npm.ts fmt
tasks.publish:npm:build:parse: wasm-pack build crates/tsv_wasm --target bundler --release --scope fuzdev --out-dir pkg/npm-parse -- --features ast && deno run --allow-read --allow-write=crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/npm-parse --allow-run=gzip scripts/publish_patch_npm.ts parse
tasks.publish:npm:build: deno task publish:npm:build:fmt && deno task publish:npm:build:parse
tasks.publish:npm:fmt: deno task publish:npm:build:fmt && cd crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/npm-fmt && npm publish --access public
tasks.publish:npm:parse: deno task publish:npm:build:parse && cd crates/tsv_wasm/pkg/npm-parse && npm publish --access public
tasks.publish:npm: deno task publish:npm:fmt && deno task publish:npm:parse
